name: Nosferatu Zod
description: (Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:flying)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:large-size)(Character)Zod is an Apostle tied to the God Hand, with inhuman strength, agelessness, and regeneration. Long-lived and proficient in both "human" and "Apostle" forms, he tears steel easily and resists conventional weapons. In Apostle form he can also fly.
